steps.title: A development build
steps.text: `mode: 'development'` turns off minifying, so `bundle.js` stays readable, and `devtool: 'inline-source-map'` puts a source map inside it. A source map links each line of the bundle back to the line of your own code that produced it. The page still loads a single script.
steps.textZh: `mode: 'development'` 关掉了压缩，所以 `bundle.js` 保持可读；`devtool: 'inline-source-map'` 把一份 source map 放进了它里面。source map 把打包产物里的每一行，对应回你自己代码里生成它的那一行。页面加载的仍然只有一个脚本。

watch.label: Page scripts (not counting the guide)
watch.labelZh: 页面脚本（不含说明面板）

steps.title: Click the button
steps.text: `printMe` from `src/print.js` prints `I get called from print.js.` in the console below, then opens an alert that says `trigger from button :)`. Close the alert to go on.
steps.textZh: `src/print.js` 里的 `printMe` 先在下面的控制台打印 `I get called from print.js.`，再弹出提示框 `trigger from button :)`。关掉提示框再继续。

steps.title: The map sits at the end of bundle.js
steps.titleZh: source map 就在 bundle.js 末尾
steps.text: The last line of `bundle.js` is a comment that holds the whole map as a `data:` URL. This step fetches the file, decodes the map and lists the files of yours that it names. The developer tools read the same comment, which is why they can show `src/index.js` and `src/print.js` although the page loaded only `bundle.js`.
steps.textZh: `bundle.js` 的最后一行是一条注释，以 `data:` URL 的形式装着整份 source map。这一步会获取这个文件，解码 source map，列出其中属于你的文件。开发者工具读的也是这行注释，所以页面明明只加载了 `bundle.js`，它们却能显示 `src/index.js` 和 `src/print.js`。

action.run: fetch('bundle.js').then((r) => r.text()).then((t) => { const last = t.trim().split('\n').pop(); console.log('last line starts with:', last.split(';')[0]); const map = JSON.parse(atob(last.split('base64,')[1])); console.log('your files in the map:', map.sources.filter((s) => s.startsWith('webpack:///./src/')).sort().join(', ')); console.log('bundle.js size:', (new Blob([t]).size / 1000000).toFixed(2), 'MB'); })

steps.actionLabelZh: 解码 bundle.js 里的 source map
expectConsole: your files in the map: webpack:///./src/index.js, webpack:///./src/print.js

steps.title: Read your own files in DevTools
steps.titleZh: 在 DevTools 里读你自己的文件
steps.text: Open the developer tools, go to **Sources** (**Debugger** in Firefox) and open the `webpack://` section: `src/print.js` is there as you wrote it. Set a breakpoint on its `console.log` line and click the page's button: the debugger stops in your file, not somewhere inside `bundle.js`.
steps.textZh: 打开开发者工具，进入 **Sources** 面板（Firefox 里叫 **Debugger**），展开 `webpack://` 分组：`src/print.js` 就在那里，和你写的一模一样。在它的 `console.log` 那一行设一个断点，再点击页面上的按钮：调试器停在你的文件里，而不是 `bundle.js` 深处的某一行。
